notes.title: Early access Waves Mode already available in demo version!
notes.notes:
The long-awaited update with Waves mode 1.2.0 is already available!

Innovation:


1. Waves

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138216/3fd9cb16f25a01ce3c0ba86cf028a5c2e1642151.png[/img]

One of the main innovations is the “Waves". This mode is an endless spawn of enemies. 

Collect as many points as you can by killing mobs!


In the future, namely with the release of the game, there will be a leader on the board. 



New mobs in Waves:

- Svinonatka

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138216/44371f7a7bf98d25758f1f2519e0dbf069a3c453.png[/img]

The sow crawls around the map and spawns new enemies every 15 seconds. 


Possesses:

200 health units 

deals a blow to the arm for 4 health points

The movement speed is 400.



- The nos



The nose is a very mobile enemy. It can appear from the Sow or during the next round of waves.


Possesses:

50 health units 

he strikes with his hand for 6 health points

The movement speed is 600.

2. New weapons


- Minigun


Quick-firing, shoots bullets and deals 20 damage.


- RPG


Shoots rocket shells at the terrain. The missile does 120 damage.


- Plasmagane


It fires energy projectiles that deal 35 damage points.


- THE BOOK 


A hellish book that incinerates enemies with a single spell.

3. Achievements 


 We also added 8 achievements, unfortunately, they are not linked to Steam. In the demo version, they will be deleted in the future. Already in the full version, they will be linked to Steam as the leader of the playing field. 


 1. The door in the middle of the forest - Complete level 1

 2. 1488 - 1488 enemies killed

 3. Overdose - death 100 times

 4. The band is an 800 hp healing.

 5. AAAAAAAAA - 5,000 enemies killed (in waves)

 6. Mephedrone Rambo - Fired 6666 machine gun shots

 and 2 unlocked achievements.


Minor innovations:

- The design of the 1st level has been slightly updated and optimized. 
- Loading screen
- Renamed level 1
- Updated the level selection menu
- Removed the body of the character in the nightmare
- The toxic flower sound now plays better
- Nightmare lvl update 



	 	

	 	

Fixed:
- Fixed some trees
- Removed the character's body from "nightmare"
- The sound of "poisonous flower" is now reproduced better
- Fixed music looping in the menu
- Fixed music looping on level 1
- Changed the location of weapons



Changes after the beta version:

- Removed "War - Hexenkessel" (Waves)
- Updated mob designs

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Preparing demo 1.2.0 for the release version
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! The development of "Waves" is already coming to an end and we want to show what has been changed since the release of the public test version 1.2.0

A full description of the test 1.2.0 update can be found here:
https://www.demonicinteractive.ru/description-of-the-update-public-beta-demo-1-2-0
Level with Waves:

We decided to completely change the level textures. The lighting on the walls has improved.

Was

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138216/5b8e8a4650f61c075d3b717aa2c5c4c296f95941.png[/img]

It became

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138216/3fd9cb16f25a01ce3c0ba86cf028a5c2e1642151.png[/img]

Level 1:

The textures of trees and ground were also changed in the level. We also reduced the level - which should affect optimization. Trees were added outside and the flat tree texture was removed.

Was

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138216/d1e47d1071681d33603351136f33b1ed6ced38d1.png[/img]

It became

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138216/b7d73aa21c1bce29f947e7e3fdbc3b65d363b5ae.png[/img]

You will learn about other changes in the description of update 1.2.0; the update will be released approximately at the end of February or at the beginning of March.

Work on the level 2 layout was criminalized. We will show it in the 3rd devlog
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138216/caf2018521807723a84e3a1d9b17eeb356521586.png[/img]
